text:
marco: Heads-up — planning to enable model comet-11b-quant in the catalog during the Thu change window (2024-08-12 17:00 UTC). Need a quick fallback ordering review and pin list. Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~2h. Any objections?

emily: :eyes: Can we set fallback to comet-7b-quant first, then titan-3b? We saw titan drift on lex evals last week.

sasha: Agree with that order: [comet-7b-quant, titan-3b, llama13b-int8]. Also suggest pin titan-3b for 24h in case we need to roll back.

oliver: Pin windows proposal: 1h canary pin -> 6h mid pin -> 24h full pin. Be conservative for EU traffic.

amy: Add metrics guards: p99 latency, error_rate, and eval_hallucination_rate. If any goes >5% relative, auto-rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by marco at 2024-08-12T17:00:00Z. Canary: 5% traffic. Automated metrics checks enabled.

ivan: What’s the rollback signal? If CANARY fails do we auto-rollback to previous catalog version or route to fallback model?

marco: Auto-rollback -> promote fallback chain. We'll mark previous catalog version pinned and drain the new model. Manual rollback still possible via `/catalog rollback <version>`.

emily: Proposed catalog config snippet: ```json
{
  "model": "comet-11b-quant",
  "canary_percent": 5,
  "fallback_order": ["comet-7b-quant","titan-3b","llama13b-int8"],
  "pin_policy": {"canary_hours": 1, "mid_hours": 6, "full_hours": 24},
  "metrics_guards": ["p99_latency","error_rate","eval_halluc_rate"],
  "rollback_thresholds": {"error_rate": 0.05, "eval_halluc_rate": 0.05}
}
```

sasha: LGTM. Add a line to release notes: "Quantized Comet 11B enabled; expect ~15% token cost reduction vs previous."

amy: Ops note: dedicated customers must be exempt from canary (no dedicated traffic in canary).

deploy-bot: :rocket: Canary started at 2024-08-12T17:00:00Z (5%). Monitoring windows open.

deploy-bot: metric-check: p99_latency=84ms (+1%), error_rate=0.8% (<5%), eval_halluc_rate=0.9% (<5%) -> passing.

marco: :thumbsup: If metrics remain stable we'll go to 25% in 30m. @ivan pls watch logs.

ivan: Watching. Will ping on anomalies. If error_rate spikes >3% I'll trigger manual hold.

oliver: EU routing question — confirm mid-phase pin_by_region so EU can be pinned earlier? Don't want cross-region drift.

marco: Yes — mid pin will be region-aware. I'll add pin_by_region: {EU: mid after 25%}.

deploy-bot: :warning: At 2024-08-12T17:27:00Z, canary error_rate spike detected to 4.5% (from 0.8%). Pausing rollout, holding at 5%.

amy: Thanks for auto-pause. Can we collect sample requests and run quick eval? @emily can you run eval set `prod-smoke-200`?

emily: Running now. ETA ~7m.

deploy-bot: samples collected: 200 requests. Uploaded to /artifacts/comet-11b-quant/canary-4912345678.

emily: Results: hallucination_rate jumped on long-form prompts +3.5% absolute. Looks like KV cache handling for the quant variant is slightly off.

sasha: Ok revert plan — promote comet-7b fallback and pin catalog to previous stable version. Who will run rollback?

marco: I'll run rollback in 2m: `/catalog rollback 2024-08-11T22:13:00Z` then drain the new model.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated by marco at 2024-08-12T17:37:00Z. Starting drain and routing to fallback models.

deploy-bot: rollback complete at 2024-08-12T17:38:05Z. Catalog pinned to 2024-08-11T22:13:00Z. Canary artifacts saved.

oliver: Good. Follow-up: open regression ticket to fix KV-cache quant path and assign to eng-ml.

amy: Create a postmortem-lite in #postmortems and include telemetry snapshots + eval diffs.

marco: Will open ticket and postmortem. Thanks everyone for quick responses. We'll rework the quant runtime and reattempt later.
